summary: WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp., a BVI-domiciled space technology company, announced via Form 6-K that its previously announced business combination with blank-check company Columbus Acquisition Corp closed on October 1, 2026, following shareholder approval at a September 30, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Pubco ordinary shares begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker SAIQ on October 2, 2026. Maxim Group LLC advised WISeSat; Ellenoff Grossman & Schole and Harney Westwood & Riegels served as legal counsel, while Loeb & Loeb and Ogier represented CAC. No price, premium, or redemption figures were disclosed. Watch post-closing trading, redemption levels, and lock-up expirations for arbitrage dynamics.
